limiar: Youden na validacao, no melhor checkpoint
train_transform:
Compose(
    Grayscale(num_output_channels=3)
    PadToSquare()
    Resize(size=(224, 224), interpolation=bilinear, max_size=None, antialias=True)
    RandomHorizontalFlip(p=0.5)
    RandomRotation(degrees=[-10.0, 10.0], interpolation=nearest, expand=False, fill=0)
    ColorJitter(brightness=(0.9, 1.1), contrast=(0.9, 1.1), saturation=(0.95, 1.05), hue=(-0.02, 0.02))
    RandomAffine(degrees=[0.0, 0.0], translate=(0.05, 0.05))
    ToTensor()
    Normalize(mean=[0.485, 0.456, 0.406], std=[0.229, 0.224, 0.225])
)
eval_transform:
Compose(
    Grayscale(num_output_channels=3)
    PadToSquare()

)
scheduler: ReduceLROnPlateau(mode=max sobre val_auc, factor=0.5, patience=5, min_lr=1e-6)
